Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a right to a live performance of Taps at a veteran's funeral.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the performance of Taps at veterans' funerals;adding a new section to chapter 73.24 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that meaningful andvenerated traditions accompany the burial of a veteran, including alive performance of the song Taps. A live performance of Taps at afuneral, alongside other traditional military rites, properly honors aveteran's life and military service at the time of burial. Prerecordedmusic is an inferior substitute. Therefore, the legislature intends toprovide the option of a live performance of Taps at every veteran'sfuneral.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 73.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each veteran, as defined in RCW 41.04.007, is entitled to aperformance of the song Taps at the veteran's funeral by a qualifiedtrumpeter, without cost or charge to the veteran. (2) The Washington state arts commission shall identify and p. 1 SB 5711maintain a list of trumpet players who are qualified to play Taps atveterans' funerals. (3) The department of veterans affairs shall hire trumpeters fromthe list maintained by the Washington state arts commission and shallpay a fee of one hundred dollars per performance.
